facts.fact: The ESCWA-drafted e-participation policy document says the Mauritanian Government 'a élaboré et approuvé en 2022' a national Digital Transformation Agenda 2022-2025; the document names no further act, decree or council.

The document states the agenda's global objectives for 2025 against 2021: digital value added from 350 million dollars (4.5% of GDP) to 700 million (8%), formal jobs from 5,000 to 15,000, and internet users from 25% to 65% of individuals, and lists 13 projects in four key initiatives; it gives no cost.
